column1: # noite plan: units, function assignments, hand-set statuses, manual unit deps.
# Generated by `noite plan export` (automatic on main); apply with `noite plan apply`.

column5: SceneObject slots 27-2E 35 37 (frames, play, playIdle, stopAndRedraw(Dc), tick, stop, getTimerId, isRunning), AnimationVtbl playOnce, animation_set_strip
the WinG shell: WinMain, app_init, AppWndProc (create, destroy, activate, paint; 0x40b hello and the 0x40c posted before every message: BUGS.md H1), message loop

Backdrop/GridBackdrop (one WinG bitmap; BackdropVtbl 20 slots, GridBackdropVtbl 21), InfernoBackdrop's ctor and create (the floor wall, row 23), the occupancy grid (occupancy_grid_clear: BUGS.md H6) and its queries, autoscroll
DIB loading, the two DIB copies and the row blitters (1000 is NOITE's byte-identical 32-bit segment)
Game + InfernoGame: ctor/dtor, GameVtbl 01-06 (createPlayer: the hero, createInitScene, onCreate: the world builders), game_init, game_take_exit, the conditions
game_handle_message (GameVtbl 00, 4.9 KB: the engine default under the INFERNO handler; its input cases are dead, the update-list tail draws every frame)
the Hazard class (coal, devil, fire): its SceneObject overrides (stopMoving, moveTick), PropVtbl moveTick (hazard_tick), spawn/despawn, hazard_hit_player (BUGS.md H6, H7), inferno_create_hazards
InfernoScene: its handler (the 3-minute clock, keys, the 5 timer tests, WM_DESTROY, WM_CLOSE and the 0x40a reports: BUGS.md H2, H4), create (MCI, WaveMix, the score box), createScreen

the Hero class (the player, a Player2D): its SceneObject overrides (play, tick, moveToEdgeV, stopMoving(Dc), moveTick: walk, jump, the world scroll), the jump, hero_collide (BUGS.md H5, H7), size toggle, pose reset
the Platform class (4 platforms carrying the drinks): its SceneObject overrides (play, moveToEdgeH, moveTick), PlatformVtbl moveTick (platform_tick, the respawn), drop_cross, inferno_create_platforms
ObjectList (head only in INFERNO), UpdateList (out of line in /Od)
SceneObject slots 2F-34 36 (moveTo, edges, stopMoving(Dc), moveTick, isMoving), MoverVtbl placeAt (every table's slot 00), mover_step/at_target
constructors and destructors of the objects (Hero, Platform, Prop, Hazard; Player2D/Actor2D/Mover/Animation, SceneObject) and the frames (FrameVtbl getCell)
SceneObject slots 22-26 (occupy, vacate, attach, canStep, isStepBlocked) and reattach

SceneObject slots 00-11 38 (Object3D getters/setters: defaults only, INFERNO builds no Object3D), 08-0C getX/getY/getStep, 39 setPosition, 4C getSceneName, 4E/4F overlap tests, 50/51 54/55 defaults; the /Od out-of-line accessors (strip, size, frame, dib); next_object_id, message_box_printf

the Prop class (drinks, rocks, the cross): its SceneObject overrides (restoreBackground, moveToEdgeH, moveTick; slot 5A isPowerUp), PropVtbl moveTick/stepMove/tryStep, the cross tick, inferno_create_rocks_and_cross
SceneObject slots 12-1A (dirty rects, overlap, restoreBackground, drawDirtyTo, draw, drawClip(To), erase, slot1F) and the DC hooks
Scene methods (SceneVtbl 01-04 06 08-0C), ctors (InfernoScene's too), scene_create and the destructors, exits
the score box and its changes: inferno_lose_life (-500, a life, WM_DESTROY at 0: BUGS.md H3), +150/+300/+100, blit and draw
WaveMix (the five INFERNO waves; wave_play_loop for sonicf.WAV)
SceneObject slots 1B-21 (redraw, hideAndInvalidate, blitToDc, invalidate, slot24, hide, show) and 4D redrawOverlapping
